card.name: Capital O starts and handling-verb slots
card.fires_on: A capital O that begins a word such as Oriel, Osteoarthritis or Ovcepole. It also fires on 'not' or 'be' just before handling verbs like crushed, cut or reconstituted.

modes.label: Capital O word start
modes.description: The lone letter O opens a name or a disease term, after a comma or a preposition.

modes.label: Before handling verbs
modes.description: 'not' or 'be' sits right before a verb about crushing, cutting or reconstituting a product.

modes.description: The spot between numbered preparation steps.
